2607.01921.title: Low-Latency Task-Oriented Image Transmission with Opportunistic Spectrum Access
2607.01921.paper_summary: Communication systems designed for reliable data reconstruction, rather than task-oriented communication, typically rely on separate source and channel coding and incur high latency under limited spectrum availability and fading channels. To address this, we propose a transmission framework with opportunistic spectrum access, in which the transmitter sends discrete latent representations learned via a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) over idle licensed channels using standard digital modulation. The AI-powered receiver is still able to reconstruct task-related information from the heavily compressed data. We develop a cross-layer latency model that accounts for compression, block errors, retransmissions, and stochastic channel access. Results on latency-accuracy trade-offs show that the proposed scheme achieves at least 79- and 3.3-fold latency reductions with only 5.7% and 2.4% drops in classification accuracy compared to benchmarks using conventional source and channel coding. The framework enables low-latency communication and reliable task execution even under limited spectrum availability and challenging channel conditions.
2607.01921.paper_summary_zh: 通信系統若是為了可靠的數據重建而設計，而非以任務為導向的通信，通常依賴於獨立的源編碼和通道編碼，並在有限的頻譜可用性和衰落通道下產生高延遲。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種具有機會性頻譜接入的傳輸框架，其中發射器通過向量量化變分自編碼器（VQ-VAE）學習的離散潛在表示，在空閒的授權通道上使用標準數字調變進行發送。這種人工智慧驅動的接收器仍然能夠從高度壓縮的數據中重建與任務相關的信息。我們開發了一個跨層延遲模型，考慮了壓縮、區塊錯誤、重傳和隨機通道接入。延遲與準確性的權衡結果顯示，與使用傳統源編碼和通道編碼的基準相比，所提出的方案在分類準確性僅下降5.7%和2.4%的情況下，實現了至少79倍和3.3倍的延遲減少。該框架使得即使在有限的頻譜可用性和挑戰性的通道條件下，也能實現低延遲通信和可靠的任務執行。
